title: Broadnax v. Ledbetter — unknown reward
summary: The claimant acted without knowing of the reward and could not rely on that act as acceptance of it.
notes: The notes separate awareness of an offer from the performer’s motive and raise the possibility of learning the offer during ongoing performance. The latter question points to § 51 and is not treated as resolved simply by the completed capture in Broadnax.
